h1: Custom 4 oz Products for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom 4 oz products in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Perfect for samples, giveaways, and travel-sized branding.
introHtml: Custom 4 oz products are ideal for sampling campaigns, travel-sized giveaways, or budget-friendly promotional items. This compact size fits easily into pockets, purses, or welcome kits while keeping your brand visible. Choose from options like custom 4 oz lotion bottles, stainless steel tumblers, or spray bottles for events. Screen printing or pad printing works well on these smaller surfaces, ensuring crisp logos that stand out. Whether you need hand sanitizers for a trade show or mini moisturizers for hotel amenities, 4 oz products deliver practical branding that recipients appreciate.
